name: Left-hand traffic: the California structure reflected (a placeholder, not any country's law)
status: draft: mirror image of us-california so that the machinery works on left-hand roads; no country's statute has been checked. Replace the rules with the local ones before using results.
notes: A right turn crosses the oncoming lane in left-hand traffic and yields to it; the vehicle on the right yields to the one on the left.
Many left-hand countries (UK, Japan, Australia) do not use all-way stops and give priority by sign, marking or roundabout rules. Edit all_way_stop and add rules before relying on this profile.
